description: This file defines test cases for the GatewayEnvironment component, validating version parsing, compatibility, port configuration, and version extraction functionalities.

methods.name: semver parses common forms
methods.description: Tests the parsing of various semantic version string formats into Semver objects, including stripping prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway version string is normalized by removing product prefixes before parsing.

methods.name: semver compatibility requires same major and not older
methods.description: Checks semantic version compatibility logic, ensuring major versions match and the version isn't older.

methods.name: gateway port defaults and respects override
methods.description: Tests that the gateway port defaults to a specified value and respects user override settings.

methods.name: expected gateway version from string uses parser
methods.description: Validates extraction and parsing of gateway version strings into Semver objects.
